Conan realizes that the culprit is Kae Nishiwaki. After calling everyone together to reveal the culprit's identity, Conan finds himself in a tight spot when a ball hits the tranquilizer dart he was aiming at Kogoro. summary.en: A young office worker named Kae Nishiwaki asked Kogoro to investigate someone who sneaks into her apartment when she goes to work. She tells him that this has happened three times and that they leave gifts each time they sneak in. Kogoro visits her apartment, with Conan tagging along, and she finds that someone has placed a suitcase in her room. Kogoro opens it to see the dead body of Ryuko Kusakabe, Kae's boss, and all of them are shocked.
